title: Form AOC-4
question: What is Form AOC-4, and what if it is missed?

body.normal: Form AOC-4 files the company's audited financial statements with the Registrar of Companies every year, after the shareholders adopt them at the annual general meeting.
body.simple: AOC-4 sends the company's yearly accounts to the Registrar.
body.detail: Each year the board approves the financial statements, the auditor reports on them and the shareholders adopt them at the AGM. AOC-4 then places them on the public record, with the board's report and auditor's report attached.
body.why: Unfiled accounts show on the public record and block other filings over time.

facts.v: Yearly filing of audited financial statements
Your firm prepares and files it; you approve the figures
An additional fee for each day of delay, and penalties on the company and its directors if it stays unfiled.
